manufacturer.digital_transfer: Two bytes, high byte first, 15-bit pressure word. This is not the Honeywell 14-bit pressure/status format.

design_direction.fixed_electronics: Pressure transducers at the wrist/bench; short measured tubes connect to the contact chambers.
